spec.hook: AN ITALY LEGEND NEEDED 58 GAMES FOR THE SAME
spec.fact: THE FIRST TO SCORE 9 IN HIS FIRST 14 GAMES FOR ITALY
voice: Pio Esposito: nine goals in fourteen games for Italy. An Italy legend needed fifty-eight games for the same nine. Can you name him?
Clue one: he won the World Cup in two thousand and six.
Clue two: twenty-five seasons at one club.
Francesco Totti. Nine goals in fifty-eight games for Italy. Esposito has the same nine in fourteen.
That is more than four times as often.
Can he catch Gigi Riva's record of thirty-five? Tell us in the comments.
spec.caption:
Pio Esposito has 9 goals in 14 games for Italy: Francesco Totti scored his 9 in 58.

Esposito's brace against France took him to nine Italy goals, level with Totti, and no one had scored nine in his first 14 games for Italy. Goals per game: Esposito 0.64, Totti 0.16.

Can he catch Gigi Riva's Italy record of 35? Comment his final tally 👇

Sources: Wikipedia (Italy caps and goals, read 14 November 2026), GOAL

spec.title: Harry Kane level with Robert Lewandowski on 92 international goals
spec.hook: ONE PENALTY THIS WEEK. 92 FOR HIS COUNTRY. WHO IS HE?
spec.head:
LEVEL WITH
LEWANDOWSKI
spec.fact: AND A RECORD 126TH CAP: PAST PETER SHILTON
spec.factSub: 8 MORE FOR THE FIRST 100 BY AN ENGLAND MAN
voice: Ninety-two. One penalty this week, ninety-two for his country. Who is he?
Harry Kane. Level with Robert Lewandowski on ninety-two international goals... and eight short of a hundred.
England beat Croatia two-one at Wembley, and Kane won a record hundred and twenty-sixth cap. Will he get to a hundred?
spec.caption:
Harry Kane is level with Robert Lewandowski on 92 international goals.

His penalty in England's 2-1 win over Croatia at Wembley took him to 92 goals for England, and the game was his 126th cap, an England record past Peter Shilton. Eight more and he is the first England man to 100.

Will he get to 100? 👇

Sources: Wikipedia (England and Poland caps and goals, read 14 November 2026), Yahoo Sports

spec.head: POCHETTINO IS MANCHESTER UNITED'S NEW HEAD COACH
voice: Breaking: Mauricio Pochettino is Manchester United's new head coach. Here are the numbers behind the news.
His club record. Espanyol: thirty-three per cent wins. Southampton: thirty-eight. Tottenham: fifty-five. Paris Saint-Germain: sixty-five. Chelsea: fifty-one.
His first four games: Liverpool away, Sporting away in the Champions League, Brentford at home... then Newcastle away.
How many points does he take at Anfield? Comment zero, one or three.
spec.caption:
Mauricio Pochettino's managerial record and his first Manchester United games.

Manchester United have named Pochettino head coach; he starts on 18 November. His win rate, club by club (all competitions): Espanyol 33%, Southampton 38%, Tottenham 55%, Paris Saint-Germain 65%, Chelsea 51%.

His first four games: Liverpool (away, 22 Nov), Sporting CP (away, Champions League, 25 Nov), Brentford (home, 28 Nov), Newcastle (away, 2 Dec).

How many points does he take at Anfield? Comment 0, 1 or 3 👇

Sources: Wikipedia (managerial statistics, read 14 November 2026), ESPN fixtures
